_doc: SITE-PINS-1: every status pin and honest gap on the public site, each tied to a docs/issues item (owner, trigger, done check) and to code paths that must exist. Source for site/roadmap-data.js; scripts/build_site_roadmap.py --check enforces it.

pins.name: Heartbeat loop
pins.what: A 10-minute tick reconciles state, claims the top ready item, dispatches it to a role, verifies and writes back.

pins.name: Virtual managers and staff
pins.what: Portfolio, project and product managers plus operations, reviewer and staff roles, each a plain file in agents/roles with limits in seed/autonomy/policy.json.

pins.name: Plussing
pins.what: A protected share of capacity (default 20%) goes to improvements so work does not collapse into bug fixes; every closed item proposes a plus.

pins.name: Earned-trust autonomy
pins.what: A trust ledger widens or narrows what each role may do from graded outcomes, by reviewed change only.

pins.name: Probes with automatic revert
pins.what: Each deploy declares probes; a probe that passed before and fails after reverts the push and files its own issue.

pins.name: Ultrastable runs on itself
pins.what: Its roadmap, issues, managers and specs run on the same code it gives everyone.

pins.name: Other clouds
pins.what: Deploy briefs exist for Cloudflare, Google Cloud, AWS and Azure (/deploy.md); only Cloudflare is proven in production.

pins.name: Chat-thread front door
pins.what: A pill input with dictation, rotating suggestions, tap-to-answer questions, then each build step shown as it runs. The front door refuses definite one-offs before building; adaptive follow-up questions are tracked separately.

pins.name: Executor opens its own merged pull request
pins.what: The executor opened pull requests 749 and 762 itself and both merged on 2026-11-20. Both were mechanical fixes (an unused import removed); a change written by a model has not merged yet.
pins.where: probe: a pr-merged row in ops/executor-log.jsonl

pins.name: Fresh-account bootstrap
pins.what: The first real --apply of a brand-new organization on an empty Cloudflare account has not run yet.

pins.name: Packaged installer and second installation
pins.what: Today there is one installation. A second independent one is the first pilot milestone.

pins.name: Core separated from QNFO's database
pins.what: The core still shares a database with QNFO's other applications.

pins.name: Outside audit of prediction scoring
pins.what: The match rate is scored by the system itself; a held-out grader, then an independent audit, is a pilot goal.

pins.name: Adaptive interview
pins.what: After each answer the next question is chosen from what was said: a bound model proposes it, a rule table is the floor, at most four questions.

pins.name: Default policy pack
pins.what: A short buyer-facing pack of eight plain rules over the full policy; the bootstrapper loads it, refuses a pack that promises more than the policy allows, and writes org/policy-pack.json.

pins.name: Dashboard preview and pilot model
pins.what: A public dashboard computed from the repository (loops, objectives, failure modes, capabilities, roadmap, earned autonomy) and the bring-your-own-account pilot model with its revenue hypotheses as data. The live tick feed reads each deployed runtime's /health when the page loads.

pins.name: Pilot applications and layered systems
pins.what: The pilot is an application program whose form scores answers against the four system-test questions; the bootstrapper records parent and level and the measure step is scoped to its own tenant. Every spinoff is a level-1 child that answers /health; the parent probes it (instances/ultrastable/child-link.json).

pins.name: Tenant isolation
pins.what: Tenant 0 (Ultrastable on itself) and customer tenants share one shape; the dashboard takes a tenant id and unknown tenants 404; items, claims, gate cards and trust rows carry a tenant id, and a runtime measures, claims, closes and counts only its own tenant's rows. The trust table's primary key does not carry the tenant yet, so a foreign trust row at the same key is left untouched rather than shared.

gaps: One installation and one customer. There is no installer and no second tenant yet.
The core still shares a database with QNFO's other applications; separating it is the first pilot milestone.
The prediction match rate is scored by the system itself. An outside audit is a pilot goal.
